players.product: inspection & metrology for HBM / 2.5D advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: Camtek investor presentation, figures not yet on the node: the updated target model puts non-GAAP gross margin at 55-56% at $1.2B of revenue, versus 51-52% currently (based on Q2'2026 results) and 48% in 2023; current non-GAAP operating margin is 27-28% (page 38 chart). Camtek at a glance (page 1 figure): more than 300 customers including all top 20 semiconductor manufacturers, 750+ employees, more than $800M of cash, deposits and cash equivalents, and a ~25% revenue CAGR from 2019 to 2025. Non-GAAP R&D expense is planned at $58M in 2026F (~9.5% of sales) after $43M in 2025, and service and software revenue was $28M in 2025 (6% of revenue). 2026 tools split (page 25 chart): 60% 2D inspection systems, 25% inspection tools with a 3D bump metrology sensor and 15% dedicated 3D bump metrology systems. The deck says the financial model reflects goals/targets, not guidance.
quarterly_data.figure: gross margin target 55-56% at $1.2B (current 51-52%); 2026 tools 60% inspection / 25% inspection + 3D sensor / 15% bump metrology; R&D $58M 2026F

quarterly_data.signal: Camtek investor presentation, product and technology roadmap: the deck states HBM5 is expected to continue using micro-bump interconnect (page 17 figure), with micro-bump scaling from 6 um today to 5 um next and 3 um possible. The 2027-28 inspection roadmap targets hybrid bonding with sensitivity down to 150nm, sub-150nm defect detection, post-hybrid-bonding void detection, AI-based inspection, specialty markets (photonics, CMOS, RF, MEMS, power, low-end logic, discrete) and a next-generation platform with higher throughput; the metrology roadmap covers micron-level TSV, post-CMP roughness and copper dishing metrology for hybrid bonding, pre-bond high-throughput wafer and die warpage, and bumps below 5 um for future HBM5. The portfolio comprises the Hawk family (chiplets, HBM and hybrid bonding), the Eagle G5 family (advanced packaging), the NanoProf metrology family and the 360 SCAN add-on module for backside and perimeter inspection. In silicon photonics Camtek targets new process steps in DFB laser production on InP wafers and in PIC fabrication.
quarterly_data.figure: HBM5 expected to continue micro-bump; hybrid bonding sensitivity down to 150nm
